verdict.line: You win by chaining Q (Thundering Smash) all-ins before level 6; you lose if the game drags on and Sion's Enrage-stacked health plus Cannibalism sustain take over.

brief.thesis: Volibear's early all-in power off Q (Thundering Smash) into double W (Frenzied Maul) is why he holds both the lane advantage and the solo-kill advantage here, but Sion's Enrage permanently stacks max health on every kill and Cannibalism (R) adds hard sustain once it unlocks, which is why the measured head-to-head win rate still sits at only 43.4% over 129 games despite the lane edge.

theirWindow.when: Sion backs into brush before trading
theirWindow.what: Cryptic Gaze (Q, 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown) can be cast from inside brush with no visible windup until the stun lands, per the matchup data's own callout — don't walk up blind to a brush-adjacent Sion.

yourWindow.when: Sion starts the Cryptic Gaze channel
yourWindow.what: Engage immediately with Q (Thundering Smash) to close distance and stun him first, then follow with E (Sky Splitter) for the slow, damage, and shield — this is the exact edge the data flags for taking the upper hand.

powerCurve.note: Death's Caress (W) shield blocks early pokes
Q into double W wins all-ins

start.why: 76.6% pick rate and a 46.6% win rate over 131 games — the mana regen keeps you spamming Frenzied Maul (W) and Sky Splitter (E) early, and the AP feeds Volibear's magic-damage on-hit passive.

boots.why: 47.2% win rate over 36 games, well above Plated Steelcaps' 36.5% in this matchup — the tenacity cuts the lock time from Cryptic Gaze's stun and the magic resist buys you room in extended trades.

core.why: First item in both top build paths; the attack speed and healing fuel your double-W (Frenzied Maul) trade pattern.
Cooldown refund on crit brings Q (Thundering Smash) and E (Sky Splitter) back online faster for repeated all-ins.
Highest win-rate third item in the sample at 57.1% over 7 games — the damage reflect and grievous wounds punish Sion's Enrage auto-attack trades directly.

situational.when: fights are dragging long and you need the extra healing and cooldown reduction to out-sustain Sion's own regen
Sion is stacking max health off Enrage kills and starting to out-tank your damage
you need the wave clear and mobility to poke and kite him down from range instead of brawling

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking attack speed rewards landing both Frenzied Maul (W) casts in a trade and keeps scaling through extended skirmishes.

summoners.why: Run at 73.7% pick rate with a 45.5% win rate, and Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills once Q (Thundering Smash) lands the stun.

playing.title: Punish Q's early cooldown
playing.detail: At levels 1-3, Cryptic Gaze sits on a 12-second cooldown; once Sion uses it to zone or last-hit, you have a clean window to walk up with Thundering Smash (Q) into double Frenzied Maul (W) without eating the stun.

playing.title: Never approach brush blind
playing.detail: Sion can channel Cryptic Gaze from inside a brush with no visible tell until the stun connects — hold vision or bait him out before committing melee range.

playing.title: Collapse on the Q channel
playing.detail: If you catch him mid-cast, immediately Q (Thundering Smash) to close and stun him first, then E (Sky Splitter) for the slow, damage, and shield.

playing.title: Always double-tap W
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul's 5-second cooldown lets you recast on the same marked target for bonus damage and a heal — use both casts every trade to offset his Enrage self-damage race.

playing.title: Stop long trades after level 6
playing.detail: Cannibalism (R) leeches life and buffs his attack speed on a 90-second cooldown once unlocked; past this point, burst with your own Stormbringer (R) instead of grinding it out.

playing.title: Hold E for his all-in
playing.detail: Save Sky Splitter's 16-second cooldown for when Sion commits to an Enrage all-in — the slow lets you kite while his own ability drains his health.

playing.title: Take the lead to sidelanes by 11
playing.detail: Since his Enrage-stacked health and sustain start eroding your edge mid-game, convert your early lane lead into splitpush and objectives rather than extended skirmishes.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade patterns are my own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Sion’s (Q) used from inside a brush. Attack him with [Q][E] while he is charging up (Q) to gain the upper hand.
